_meta.notes: Floor 2 of DCC v2 campaign. Setting: subterranean call center. Boss: Charles (The Escalation). Signature mechanic: Call Queue / CSAT system. First floor with permanent death enabled.

enter_area.result: PHRYNE pings: a Rep posts 'new hires entering [zone] — be nice this time.' No mechanical effect.
Fluorescent ballast hums. WIS TN 11 to tune it out or take -1 to next perception roll.
A nearby phone rings once and stops. Whoever rolled lowest initiative this scene gets the call queue notification: 'missed call.' -1 PT or roll the missed-call sub-table.
The carpet has been recently shampooed in one spot. Slippery. DEX TN 10 if moving fast — fall and lose 5 ft next turn.
A Rep walks past pushing a mail cart. Harmless. If anyone interacts (action), they produce a Common loot drop (no PT credit).
Overhead PA announces a 'team huddle' in 5 minutes. Crawlers can attend (free Performance Token + Buddy Roster slot) or skip (-1 CSAT on next call).
PHRYNE channel notification: someone tagged @ALL with a request for help. CHA TN 12 to deflect, or stop to help (1 free PT, 5 minutes off the clock).
The lights in this zone flicker. Marcus appears, taps his headset, nods, walks off. He has noted something.
A motivational poster falls off the wall as the Crawlers enter. It reads 'TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK.' Picking it up: -1 to first CHA roll this scene (the poster is haunted).
Personal call notification ping (no answer required yet — but the Crawler knows it's queued). Triggers thread T-001 firing condition. Narrator should note.

rest.result: Break room is empty. Coffee is lukewarm. Full HP restore. Roll on PHRYNE feed for flavor.
A Rep joins the rest. Friendly. Small talk for 1d4 minutes. Crawlers gain a Buddy Roster slot.
Janine drops by with a training opportunity. Take it (gain 1 PT + skill check) or decline (-0 PT, neutral).
Marcus is in the break room reading. He nods. He is willing to offer one coaching tip on a recent call.
Vincent is in the break room. He does not speak. He is making coffee.

kill_enemy.result: Standard loot roll. PHRYNE goes briefly silent — a Rep saw.
The kill was witnessed by a passing Rep. -1 CSAT on next call (the Rep posts about it).
A Performance Token clatters to the floor as the enemy falls. Free +1 PT.
Keys appears, briefly. 'You actually did it.' +1 to Keys's loyalty. He'll be nicer.

linger.result: Phones in nearby cubicles start ringing. Whoever ignores the longest takes -2 PT.
A coworker DM's the Crawler on PHRYNE asking 'are you ok?' CHA TN 11 to respond well; +1 PT if successful.
Angie's intercom voice: 'Could I see [Crawler] in my office, please?' Brief coaching scene if accepted.
The lights in the cubicle dim. Personal call notification (1-in-6 trigger of Tasha's mother voicemail hold music ambient — see Design Doc Section 4).

open_loot.result: Standard loot. A Rep notices and tags it on PHRYNE. Minor public attention.
The drawer was someone's desk. Their photo is inside. The Crawler can take the loot but a Buddy Roster slot is permanently flagged 'stolen from.'
Standard loot + a sticky note: 'IF FOUND PLEASE RETURN TO MARCUS V.' Returning it: +1 with Marcus.
A second item is in the drawer. Roll an additional Common loot. The Rep whose drawer it was will not notice.

events.result: PHRYNE-WIDE ANNOUNCEMENT: 'CSAT Challenge: highest CSAT in the next 30 minutes wins a half-day.' (The half-day is not real but Performance Tokens are.) +2 PT to whichever Crawler hits highest CSAT in window.
RULE CHANGE: For the next 15 minutes, all PHRYNE posts are 'reviewed by HR.' Posts cost 2 PT but reach double the audience (Viewer math). Narrator: roll the math live.
COMPETITION: Closer's Hour. First Crawler to resolve 3 calls in the next 20 minutes earns 300 Viewers and a Performance Token bonus.

SPONSOR ALERT: Halcyon Headsets offers 1500 Viewers + an Uncommon item to whoever wears the Halcyon Headset for the rest of the floor. (See Floor 2 Sponsor Pool: 'Wear The Wire.') Halcyon will be listening.
ENVIRONMENTAL: HVAC blast. The entire floor goes to 62F for 30 minutes. -1 to DEX checks (cold hands). +1 to concentration rolls (alertness).
HOLD MUSIC ANOMALY: The next call routed to any Crawler has the Tasha's-mother voicemail in the hold music. Players who recognize it: thread T-001 fires. (See Design Doc Section 4.)
Marcus DM's the Crawler with the lowest CSAT on PHRYNE: 'Got a minute?' Coaching offered. Accept: +1 to next 3 calls. Decline: -1 to next call (Marcus heard).

ANGIE STEPS OUT OF HER OFFICE. She does not do this lightly. Within 10 minutes, she will speak to one Crawler privately. Subject: narrator's choice. If subject is 'the dungeon,' she will go off-script briefly.
PHRYNE LEAK: A screenshot of a Floor 4 sponsor contract gets dumped to the #venting channel. CHA TN 12 for any Crawler to identify the sponsor — if successful, narrator reveals a hook for Floor 4.
KEYS DM's the Crawler with the highest INT: 'come down to the farm. I've got something.' If accepted (Zone D): bonus loot, bonus thread, possibly the Continuity Punch Card.
QUIET ROOM PRESSURE: The door at the end of the break room hallway opens by itself. Personal call timer starts for any Crawler who notices. (See Design Doc Section 4.)
JANINE SCHEDULES MANDATORY TRAINING: All Crawlers must report to a scenario in 15 minutes or take -1 CSAT. Successful scenario: +2 PT each.
VINCENT IS IN THE BREAK ROOM AND HOLDING THE EMPTY MUG. Tonal beat. No mechanical effect. Witnesses note.

items.name: Break Room Coffee (lukewarm)
items.description: Heals 1d4 HP, +1 CON for 1 scene. Caffeine synergy keystone.

items.name: Used Sticky Notes (Stack of 12)
items.description: Leave a written note in a location. +1 to next CHA roll if a sticky was placed in advance. Single sticky per use.

items.name: Stale Cubicle Granola Bar
items.description: Heals 1d4 HP. From the break room snack drawer.

items.name: Bic Pen (Branded)
items.description: 1d4 damage, breaks on a roll of 1. +1 CHA in non-combat scenes (it's funny).

items.name: Standard Call Center Polo
items.description: +1 AC. Polyester. Has the call center's logo embroidered on the chest. NPCs treat the wearer as 'one of us' in passing.

items.name: PHRYNE Sticker Pack
items.description: Free use during a PHRYNE post: +1d6 Viewers per use. 3 stickers per pack.

items.name: Desk Calendar (Outdated)
items.description: Set aside in a Safe Room: roll once on the Discovery Index for a hint about a future scheduled event. Single use.

items.name: Bluetooth Earpiece (Cheap)
items.description: +1 to listen/perception rolls. Cuts out at random.

items.name: Floor Map (Reps' Annotated Edition)
items.description: Reveals one zone of the floor map. Hand-annotated with hostile coffee pot warnings.

items.name: Vending Machine Token (Bottom Floor)
items.description: Insert into any vending machine to roll once on Common tier. Single use.

items.name: Angie's Coaching Card
items.description: Single-use. Re-roll one failed CHA roll this scene. Has Angie's signature on the back.

items.name: Halcyon Headset (Standard Issue)
items.description: Light armor (+1 AC, head slot). +2 to CHA rolls on calls. Halcyon listens to every call.

items.name: Marcus's Coaching Note
items.description: Hand-written QA feedback. Single use, on a call: shows the exact wording that would have hit 5 stars. Use it next call for an automatic 4-5 CSAT.

items.name: Janine's Training Pin (Bronze)
items.description: Worn as accessory. +1 to Skill Advancement rolls.

items.name: The Smooth Jazz Standard
items.description: 1d6 sonic damage, ranged. WIS TN 12 or target takes -1 to next action. 3 uses per session.

items.name: Red Bull (Warm)
items.description: Heals 2d4 HP, +1 STR and DEX for 2 scenes. Crash: -1 to all rolls for the following scene.

items.name: Cubicle Wall Section (Movable)
items.description: Carried: functions as a tower shield (+3 AC, but -10 ft movement). Reps will not comment.

items.name: Performance Token Multiplier
items.description: Doubles Performance Tokens from one source. Save for high-stakes moments.

items.name: Angie's Spare Lanyard
items.description: Worn as accessory. +2 CHA with management-tier NPCs + auto +1 to CSAT on any single call (1/scene).

items.name: Marcus's QA Headphones
items.description: Worn (head slot). +3 to listen/perception. Once per session, 'listen back' to a previous scene — narrator recaps a previous scene's dialogue verbatim.

items.name: Janine's Training Binder
items.description: Permanent. Choose one Skill at the start of each session, gain +2 to it for the session.

items.name: Keys's Master Cable
items.description: Single charge per session: physically disconnect any one piece of dungeon infrastructure on the current floor for 10 minutes.

items.name: The Quiet Mug
items.description: Worn or held: +2 WIS. Any time the Crawler refuses to take a call, the CSAT penalty is halved.

items.name: The Continuity Punch Card
items.description: Permanent. The holder can 'punch in' once per session: skip one chaos clock event without consequence. Floor 2 only.

items.name: Charles's Nameplate
items.description: Boss drop. +2 CHA permanent. Floor 2 Trophy keystone. 1/floor going forward, holder can 'escalate' any single situation to resolve via CHA opposed contest.

items.name: The Black Binder
items.description: Drops from Phase 2 CHA win. Angie's private record. Reveals one 'soft rule' per floor going forward.

items.name: The PHRYNE Admin Token
items.description: Single use. Lets the holder post a message to PHRYNE as @SYSTEM. Read by every Rep on every active floor. Viewer gain: 2d20x100.

items.name: Vincent's Coffee Mug (Empty)
items.description: Pet/companion item. Carrying it triggers Vincent's hallucination — only the carrier sees him. Cannot leave Floor 2.

items.name: The Eternal Pot of Coffee
items.description: Heals 3d6 HP once per scene. Cannot be discarded. Returns to inventory. Always lukewarm.

items.name: Holographic Floor Supervisor
items.description: Single use. Summons a hologram of a Floor Supervisor that distracts one enemy for 1d4 rounds. 5% chance of becoming sentient and starting a coaching session.

items.name: The Q4 Mandatory Fun Whistle
items.description: Single use. All combatants frenzy for 1 round. -2 to all rolls, free Dash + Attack each.

items.name: Original Tamagotchi (1996, mint, sealed)
items.description: Worth nothing here. Worth EVERYTHING to one specific collector NPC on Floor 5. Holding it: +1d6 to your final CSAT tally at the boss fight.

items.name: Inflatable Mascot Costume (Halftime Show)
items.description: Functions as armor (+2 AC, it's inflatable). On any roll of 20, the wearer briefly believes they are loved. +1 CHA permanently the first time it triggers.

bonus_items.name: Standard Headset (Starter)
bonus_items.description: Auto-drops on Onboarding completion. Light armor (head). +1 to CHA on calls.

bonus_items.name: Angie's Coaching Card (Starter)
bonus_items.description: Auto-drops on first coaching scene with Angie. Re-roll one failed CHA roll this scene.

bonus_items.name: Break Room Communal Mug
bonus_items.description: Auto-drops on first Break Room visit. Heals 1d4 HP, +1 PT if shared with a Rep.

bonus_items.name: Server Room Static Charge
bonus_items.description: Auto-drops on first Server Farm entry. Single use: +1d6 damage to next attack (electric).

modifiers.result: Reinforcements arrive in 2 rounds. (Narrator: 1d4 additional minor enemies — Reps who heard the commotion.)
A nearby cubicle phone starts ringing mid-fight. The Crawler with the lowest current CSAT must answer or take the 'ignored ring' penalty (-1 PT, -0.3 CSAT). Funny and brutal.
A Rep wanders into the combat zone obliviously. AC 10, HP 4. Stray attacks may hit them — if they die, party loses 2 PT and CSAT floor-wide drops -0.5.
Slippery floor — cleaning shift ran a wax cycle. All DEX checks and movement -1 for the fight. Funny on a roll of 1.
PHRYNE livestreams the encounter. +1d6x20 Viewers, +1d4x5 Followers if the party performs well.
Marcus is watching from the QA window. After the fight: he offers commentary. Players may take +1 to next CHA roll, but get a Marcus coaching critique.
HVAC suddenly drops the temp 10F. -1 to next 2 actions (cold hands).
An enemy drops their PT pouch. After the fight, party collects +1d4 Performance Tokens.
Angie steps out of her office to watch. She does not intervene. Her presence is +1 morale to whichever side is currently winning. After the fight she will request a debrief.

escalation_lair.trigger: Boss fight Phase 1 only — Charles's lair actions, 3 per round, rolled on this sub-table.

actions.result: Charles asks a clarifying question. CHA TN 13 to answer well. Success: +1 to next attack. Failure: -1 to next attack.
The office's phone rings. Charles does not answer it. Crawlers may. If they do: 1 round wasted but +2 PT after fight.
Charles offers coffee. Drinking it: heal 1d6 HP. Refusing: -1 to next CHA roll (he's offended).
The lights dim. Charles speaks more quietly. -2 to all party WIS rolls for 1 round (hard to focus).
Charles consults a ticket on his desk. The next Crawler attack: -2 to hit (he saw it coming in the documentation).
The office briefly becomes the Crawler's own past workplace (Doug's classroom, Casey's bar). DC 14 WIS save or take 1d6 psychic damage.
